question: India is ranked _______ in the World Happiness Report published in March 2025.
solution: The correct answer is __**126th**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **World Happiness Report** is an annual publication by the **United Nations Sustainable Development Solutions Network** that evaluates global happiness levels. • The report measures happiness using indicators such as **GDP per capita, social support, life expectancy, freedom to make life choices, generosity, and perceptions of corruption**. • In the **2025 World Happiness Report**, **India ranked 126th**, reflecting a decline compared to previous years. • Countries like **Finland, Denmark, and Iceland** consistently rank at the top of the report due to their strong social welfare systems and high levels of trust and equality. • India’s ranking can be attributed to challenges such as **inequality, unemployment, lack of social support systems, and corruption perceptions**.
